hooks.name: Keep specs and code in sync
hooks.description: At the end of a turn that touched backend code, ask the agent to tick off or add tasks in the matching spec and to check every Correctness Property still has a test.

action.prompt: If you changed files under backend/src in this turn, open the spec under .kiro/specs whose design.md lists those modules. Mark finished tasks with [x], add tasks for new behaviour with _Requirements_ references, and confirm every 'Property N' in design.md has a test in backend/tests/property. Report any requirement without a test.
